index {collection}.{index}: {collection}.{field} is {type_id}, which cannot be indexed.
An index can use basic values and single links (nc.link).
when: Under the lock's name, when `ncdb model build` or `ncdb model check` refuses a model that breaks a rule on its own: an index names a field of a type that cannot be indexed. Opening with such a lock shows it after error.lockInvalid's colon.
